The detector's only validated edge — the absolute-trend gate — is live (gate_helps=true), which argues for holding trend-eligible themes and de-risking ineligible ones rather than making fresh directional bets.

theses.subject: Cybersecurity
theses.thesis: Cybersecurity is the only top-5 theme showing a clean 'trend' hurst tag with the strongest breadth (0.5) among leaders, and it sits just behind the crowded memory leader. The absolute-trend gate is the one validated risk-control leg, and cybersecurity clears it with eligible=true. I'm not arguing it will beat memory — only that it's a trend-eligible, less-crowded way to stay exposed to the same risk-on leadership complex without paying for the most extended name.
evidence: crowded=true but crowding is a size-down caution, not a fade
theses.dissent: Cybersecurity is crowded (z=2.04, highest in the ranks) and attention-driven; its leadership may be a coincident flow spike that mean-reverts promptly, and gate_helps does not imply gate_predicts.

falsifier.text: CIBR lags SMH by more than 4% on a total-return basis over the next 20 trading days

theses.subject: Silver Miners
theses.thesis: Silver miners are the highest-ranked theme that is not crowded (z=0.22) and has positive breadth (0.5), giving trend exposure to the materials complex without the reflexivity risk embedded in the semiconductor leaders. Rank 4 with a passing durability bar keeps it inside the absolute-trend gate's eligible set.
theses.dissent: Silver miners have a 'mixed' hurst tag and are a beta-driven commodity proxy; if the broad risk-on complex wobbles, SIL likely falls harder than diversified sectors despite not being crowded.

falsifier.text: SIL trails GDX by 3% or more over the next 20 trading days

theses.subject: US Energy Complex
theses.thesis: Energy complex is the only major theme combining a clean 'trend' hurst tag with eligible=true and non-crowded texture (z=0.88), offering trend participation without the extension risk in leading tech. It sits mid-table but its durability bar clears the validated gate.
theses.dissent: Breadth is near zero (0.045), so the tag may rest on a handful of large weights rather than a broad move; energy also carries unscheduled headline risk given the macro backdrop is dominated by geopolitics and energy news flow.

falsifier.text: XLE lags XLE's own 20-day moving average by more than 2% over the next 20 trading days

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
